answer: A sybil fleet's weakness is coordination decay. Make each identity forge its own uncopyable history: every epoch it signs the latest beacon, binding its key to that moment, so a cloned key can't replay old standing. Strip away the velvet glove of transferable deposits — a bond movable between identities is a toll, not a wall. Anchor standing on a reef of distinct non-kin attestations, each a separate cost the attacker pays per fake identity, per epoch. Every clone needs its own forge work and its own reef of real vouches — nothing shared across the fleet.
